# sailpoint_managed_client (Data Source)

Data source for a SailPoint managed client, such as a virtual appliance (VA). Look up a managed client by `id`, or by `name` optionally narrowed with `cluster_id`. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be provided.

The API cannot filter managed clients by name, so a lookup by `name` lists every managed client and matches in the provider; it fails if zero or several managed clients match.

The client's API secret, alert key and VA download URL are never read into state. `last_seen` and `since_last_seen` change on every read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a virtual appliance by ID.
data "sailpoint_managed_client" "by_id" {
  id = "REPLACE_WITH_MANAGED_CLIENT_ID"
}

# Or by name (fails if zero or several managed clients match).
data "sailpoint_managed_client" "by_name" {
  name = "Example VA"
}

# Narrow a name lookup to one cluster.
data "sailpoint_managed_client" "in_cluster" {
  name       = "Example VA"
  cluster_id = "REPLACE_WITH_CLUSTER_ID"
}

output "va_status" {
  value = data.sailpoint_managed_client.by_name.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cluster_id` (String) The ID of the cluster the managed client belongs to. When set together with `name`, only managed clients of that cluster match. Cannot be set together with `id`.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the managed client. Mutually exclusive with `name`.
- `name` (String) The managed client name. Use as a lookup key (mutually exclusive with `id`) or read the resolved name after lookup by `id`.

### Read-Only

- `api_gateway_base_url` (String) The API gateway base URL of the managed client.
- `client_id` (String) The client ID used in API management.
- `cluster_type` (String) The type of the cluster the managed client belongs to, such as `idn`.
- `created_at` (String) When the managed client was created.
- `description` (String) The managed client description.
- `ip_address` (String) The public IP address of the managed client.
- `last_seen` (String) When the managed client was last seen by the server.
- `provision_status` (String) The provisioning status of the managed client, such as `PROVISIONED` or `DRAFT`.
- `since_last_seen` (String) Milliseconds since the managed client last polled the server.
- `status` (String) The managed client status, such as `NORMAL`, `WARNING`, `ERROR` or `NOT_CONFIGURED`.
- `type` (String) The managed client type, such as `VA` or `CCG`.
- `updated_at` (String) When the managed client was last updated.
- `va_version` (String) The version the virtual appliance is running.
